parameters.name: Devices
parameters.description: The list of devices to dissociate.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description: The DeviceName of the device to be dissociated from the project.

sub_parameters.name: ProductKey
sub_parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device to be dissociated from the project belongs.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
2. In the list of common projects, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar.
